# Amit Om, MD — Mohs Surgeon & Dermatologist in Charlotte, NC

> Dr. Amit Om is a double board-certified dermatologist and fellowship-trained Mohs micrographic surgeon in Charlotte, North Carolina. Starting December 2026 he sees patients at Piedmont Plastic Surgery & Dermatology (PPSD) at its Cotswold and Blakeney offices in Charlotte. Appointments: 704-344-8846 or https://patient.getprosperapp.com/piedmont/schedule

## Key facts

- Specialty: Mohs micrographic surgery for skin cancer (basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma and other skin cancers), dermatologic surgery and reconstruction, medical dermatology
- Board certification: American Board of Dermatology, in Dermatology and in Micrographic Dermatologic Surgery
- Fellowship: ACGME-accredited Micrographic Surgery & Dermatologic Oncology fellowship, Los Angeles, CA, mentored by Dr. Richard Bennett
- Residency: Dermatology, Florida State University
- Medical school: Medical University of South Carolina
- Undergraduate: Virginia Commonwealth University
- Memberships: American Academy of Dermatology, American College of Mohs Surgery, Alpha Omega Alpha Honor Medical Society
- Practice: Piedmont Plastic Surgery & Dermatology (PPSD), Charlotte, NC, starting December 2026
- Cotswold office: 309 S. Sharon Amity Road, Suite 200, Charlotte, NC 28211
- Blakeney office: 5815 Blakeney Park Drive, Suite 100, Charlotte, NC 28277
- Phone (PPSD appointments and physician referrals): 704-344-8846
- Telemedicine: 38,000+ virtual patients seen; licensed in 19 states
- Publications: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=amit+om
